ashley: Quick postmortem hitlist from yesterday's DB fail — need owners + dates so we can close the RCA. Please ack and set due dates by EOD.

ashley: ```
1) emergency failover script review — infra
2) alert dedupe on replica lag — eng-sre
3) runbook gap: cache warm on restart — eng-runtime
4) telemetry: add latency metric for KV sync — eng-platform
```

dan: I'll take (1). ETA Wed 2026-03-25.

priya: I can do (3) but need the runtime restart sequence. @maria can you share the sequence/docs?

maria: shared notes and a pointer in the postmortem doc: https://notion.redwood/team/rca/incident-234 — assigned to priya, due Fri 2026-03-27 :white_check_mark:

aj: (2) I'll pick this up, but I need help reproducing the lag pattern. @sam can you attach the query pattern / logs?

sam: dropping quick logs here: ```
trace: replica lag spikes at t=12:03 when bulk writes happen
query: COPY large_batch INTO table_batching
```
Also flagging a blocker: storage team has a schema migration scheduled next week that might affect (2).

priya: noted blocker. propose due Mon 2026-03-30 to wait for migration window unless we can hotpatch earlier.

ashley: OK — we'll record dependent windows on the RCA board. Can everyone CR the fixes before merge? prefer 2 reviewers.

ops-bot: Reminder: please add task IDs to the incident tracker. Use format `INC-234-A#`.

dan: ack. Filing INC-234-A1 for (1) and setting reviewer @maria.

maria: ack, will review INC-234-A1.

aj: filing INC-234-A2 for (2) and tagging storage as stakeholder.

priya: INC-234-A3 filed for runbook work, tagging eng-runtime for review.

ashley: Thanks all — I'll follow up in the PM board tomorrow with a rollup. If you need to reassign, DM me. :pray:
